history.content: Find a good time for me and Sam to work on this next week and make sure we don't forget.

Your open windows next week (this is your calendar only, I can't see Sam's): Mon Sep 28, 10:00, 11:30 AM Tue Sep 29, 1:00, 3:00 PM Thu Oct 1, 11:00 AM, 12:00 PM Fri Oct 2, 4:00, 5:30 PM That is staged as a draft for your confirmation — the calendar has not been changed yet. And so it doesn't slip, I can draft a quick email to Sam proposing the times, plus set you a reminder to confirm once he replies. Which slot do you want to lead with?
